BUYER GUIDE / BY KUMAR SAURABH MISHRA

Agree the decisions before the design.

A scope should describe what will be delivered and how you will know it is ready.

Pages and content

List the page types, approximate content volume, and who writes, supplies, and approves each item. A five-page brochure and a catalogue with hundreds of products are different projects.

Functions and integrations

Describe each visitor task: enquire, book, buy, search, or download. Name the systems it depends on and assign responsibility for accounts and access.

Acceptance and ownership

Agree device and browser checks, revision rounds, launch responsibilities, editable files, and ownership. Record exclusions as carefully as inclusions.
